strengths: Hero is close to the site hero (d-3) in a new layout. It has 1px #50504F L-bracket corners with mono callout tags straddling the frame edges ('● ORICARE 2 SKINURI' top-left; '● ORICE TELEFON' and '● AUTOMAT ÎN COȘ' bottom-right, 10px Martian Mono with a #2F2F2F border and 4px radius). The H1 is Archivo 800 at 125% stretch and -.02em. It runs −30% in solid #F5B100 at 132px, then 'LA 2' solid, then 'SKINURI.' outlined (`.ol` uses ink fill with a 2px #F3F3EF stroke and paint-order stroke fill). That matches the site's `.cv-hero--l2-outline` treatment exactly, and the inline color:#F3F3EF fallback looks fine on its own.

Its eyebrow is the most faithful of the three: a real 7px #F5B100 dot with a 3px #392B09 halo (`<div style="width:7px;height:7px;border:3px solid #392B09;border-radius:7px;background-color:#F5B100">`) beside 11px mono at .1em in #A8A8A6 or #9A9A98, the same as .cv-eyebrow.

Section 06 'COVERED ÎN CIFRE / CIFRELE CARE NE RECOMANDĂ.' is close to a pixel copy of the site stats block (d-7). It has a #111113 band, mono 01–04 indices with solid #F5B100 1px meters (pixel-verified #f5b100), large Archivo numbers with yellow '+', 10.5px mono labels and the site's own notes.

Product cards are faithful and well made. Each has a light #EFEFEB tile with a radial-gradient class, a yellow '-42%' pill, an ink '★ CEL MAI VÂNDUT' pill, a yellow mono price with the struck #8C8C8B compare-at, and a mono finish tag with rating. The cards are built as row-split table cells, so images, titles, prices and offer chips line up across each pair at both breakpoints (a-d02, a-d03, a-m03). The gutter measures 11px, which keeps the site's airy grid.

The see-all bars copy the device-picker bar: a gold hairline, an amber gradient over #121213, Archivo 800 caps, a yellow mono count (199 or 138) and a 40px yellow arrow circle. The closing 2×2 device tiles ('199 DE SKINURI / IPHONE / VEZI SKINURI →') rebuild the site's model tiles.

The footer matches d-12. It has the logo, the caps tagline, 'DIN 2018 · 37.000+ CLIENȚI · 60.000+ SKINURI', Instagram and TikTok pills, and the FIRMĂ & CONTACT ID table with mono dt/dd hairline rows, the © mono line and the 5% 'covered' watermark.

Palette discipline is the tightest of the three: only #0A0A0B, #111113, #121213, #F3F3EF, #F5B100 and the flattened neutrals from the site, with no off-palette accents. The equation panel's 32px grid and amber glow reuse the Skin Lab motif.
weaknesses: The yellow band is undersized and flat: 30px desktop and 19px mobile (`.band`), only two words, 'Tăiat laser ✦ zero volum', no tilt. Next to the site's 96px tilted marquee it reads as a ribbon, and 'Tăiat laser' is solid although the site outlines it.
On desktop the hero leaves a dead black area to the right of 'LA 2' (a-d01, x≈280–590). The 3-line headline is left-heavy inside the bracket frame.
The equation panel phones are at different scales. The Samsung Titanium is max-width 172 and the OFF Burgundy 190, and the source crops differ, so the Samsung reads smaller and flatter (a-d01).
On mobile the site card parity drops. The '★ CEL MAI VÂNDUT' pill (`class="pl hm"`) and the rating (`class="hide"`) are both hidden at ≤620px, so a-m02 and a-m03 cards show only '-25%'.
Pills, the '%' circles and card borders/radii live in classes (`.pl`, `.pc`, `.cb/.ctp/.cbt`). In clients that strip <style> they degrade to flat text highlights and borderless cards.

Section headers are repetitive: six numbered 01–06 index-plus-meter headers. On the site the meter index belongs only to the stats grid. The 'Nº 01' rows and the spec table are invented components. The page is long (~7.7k px).
Some copy is invented: the stat note 'Scorul mediu dat de clienți.' and the closing H2 'ALEGE MODELUL. ALEGE DOUĂ FINISAJE.' Both are close to the voice, but neither is site copy.

strengths: The offer panel is a faithful copy of the site's collection-grid promo tile. It has a full #F5B100 panel, '◆ OFERTĂ PACHET' in mono, a 158px Archivo 800 −30% at 125% stretch, 'LA 2 SKINURI.', and the ruler-tick divider built from `.rt0/.rm/.rM` cells. It reads as covered's own promo, and it is the highest-impact opener.
The dark cart receipt inside the panel is well made: mono struck prices, 'TOTAL ESTIMAT RON 110.60' and a yellow 'ECONOMISEȘTI RON 47.40' badge in the PDP badge style.

Product cards are closest to the site's collection cards, including the mono index '01'–'06' at the top right of the tile, the '● NOU' white pill with a yellow dot, and the '★ CEL MAI VÂNDUT' ink pill.

The closing CTA matches site d-11. It pairs a yellow '60.000+' with 'SKINURI REALIZATE.', outlines 'AL TĂU URMEAZĂ.', adds a dark cv-offer card with a '%' circle, and ends on the 3-up stats row (★ 4,69/5 · 37.000+ · 1,7) with the verbatim note 'Un singur finisaj e rareori de ajuns.'
The footer is fully on-brand, with the ID table, pills and watermark.
weaknesses: The hero gives up the site's dark hero signature: no bracket frame, no outlined display line and no amber glow. The two phone cutouts are tiny at 88px (`width="88"`), and the matte-black iPhone sits on yellow, so the composition looks underweighted next to the 158px numeral (b-d01, b-m01).

The cards are heavy and repetitive. All 14 cards carry both a '−30% CÂND IEI 2' chip and a full-width 44px 'VEZI SKINUL →' ghost button, and site cards have no buttons. Three near-identical grids plus two strips make the page monotone. The fixed title height (`.tt`) leaves visible blank lines under single-line titles, for example under 'Skin iPhone - Negru Mat' in b-d02.
The eyebrow dot is a '●' glyph in Martian Mono. It renders as a tiny square with no halo ring ('■ CELE MAI VÂNDUTE' in b-d01), unlike .cv-eyebrow__dot.
The offer strips are slim, with Archivo caps at about 15px. Without the outline alternation or the tilt they don't carry the marquee's character.
'VEZI TOATE NOUTĂȚILE →' changes to a ghost button, which breaks the see-all-bar pattern the other two sections set up.

On mobile, the best-seller pill collapses to a bare '★' circle (`★ CEL MAI VÂNDUT`), which is cryptic. The outlined 'AL TĂU URMEAZĂ.' nearly touches the 375px edges, and the CTA sub-line orphans 'secunde.' (b-m06).

Most Outlook-proof buttons. The MSO block forces '*{font-family:Arial,sans-serif!important}', which covers divs too.

The hero H1 degrades safely. The two display:block spans ('DOUĂ SKINURI.' and '−30%.') have a newline between them, so Outlook, which ignores display:block on span, still shows 'DOUĂ SKINURI. −30%.' with a space. Its Gmail link reset is safe: 'u+#body a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}' has no !important, so inline link colours still win. The offer chip and ticket rows are built from tables, not padded divs. The footer watermark has aria-hidden and mso-hide:all.

Links are correct. All 48 covered.ro links carry utm_source/medium/campaign plus a section utm_content and use &-escaped hrefs. Every target returned HTTP 200 with 0 redirects, including the hero phone links (skin-samsung-titanium, skin-iphone-duo-jet-black, skin-google-pixel-aspect-piele-neagra-full-grain). '#alege-telefonul' is placed after the query string and exists as an id on the homepage.

Alt-text colours stay readable on the cell behind each image: #B2B2AF on the dark hero, #45433E on the #EFEFEB tiles. weaknesses: Cards in a row are not bottom-aligned. On desktop, the price of 'Skin iPhone Dark - Rafinat cu Aur 22K - EDITIE SPECIALA' sits about 18px lower than the Titanium 3D price. At 375px the '★ CEL MAI VÂNDUT' pill wraps to a second line inside the tile and pushes the phone down, so tile heights in a row differ (Titanium vs Dark, Negru Mat vs Black Titanium).
The mono stack is only 'Martian Mono','Courier New',monospace. Gmail never loads the web font, so its 9.5–10.5px labels at #9A9A98/#A8A8A6 render in thin Courier New.

The tilted band relies on '.tilt{transform:rotate(-2deg);margin:14px -24px}' plus .bandwrap overflow:hidden. At 375px the rotated rows measure 404px wide and are clipped, and 'ZILE' ends about 7px from the edge. The ticket notches (<td> with border-radius) render as black squares in Outlook.

'Vezi emailul în browser' appears only in the footer; there is no top-bar link. In the 'VEZI TOATE SKINURILE …' bars only the text (about 18px tall) and the 40px circle are tappable, both under 44px. The Instagram/TikTok pills are 14+14+14 = 42px.

8 source lines are longer than 998 characters (max 5,255). That is safe only if the ESP sends quoted-printable. There is no mso-line-height-rule:exactly on the 124px/52px display lines. All three variants overflow at 320px (scrollWidth 350).

strengths: Outlook-aware touches: a VML v:roundrect on the hero 'Alege-ți telefonul' CTA, the MSO '*{font-family:Arial!important}' override, and '[data-ogsb] .tile{background-color:#EFEFEB!important}' to keep the light product wells in Outlook.com dark mode.
Best mono fallback chain: 'Martian Mono',Menlo,Consolas,'Courier New',monospace, so Gmail on iOS gets Menlo instead of thin Courier.

Card rows share <tr>s for image, info, price and offer chip across both columns, so prices and chips line up regardless of title length (verified in the 640 render). All 63 tables have role=presentation and cellpadding/cellspacing/border 0. Body, wrapper and section cells all carry bgcolor plus inline background-color.

Copy is kept in sentence case and uppercased with text-transform (89 uses), the same as the site, so screen readers get natural casing. Every covered.ro link has the full UTM set (utm_content: header/hero/top-iphone/top-samsung/noutati/cta/footer) and every target returned 200.
weaknesses: Outlook glues its block spans together. The hero H1 is '−30%la 2skinuri.' with no whitespace, so Word, which ignores display:block on span, shows '−30%LA 2SKINURI.'. The 4 closing device tiles do the same, giving '199 DE SKINURIIPHONEVEZI SKINURI →'.
Hero image alt text is unreadable with images blocked, which is Outlook's default: 'color:#45433E' on panel bgcolor #111113 is 1.91:1.
Largest file at 87,809 B. 31 lines are longer than 998 characters (max 10,128), the most line-wrap risk if the ESP does not QP-encode. Hrefs use raw '&utm_' (47 times) while img src uses &.

Several elements will not survive Outlook or GANGA. The card borders and radii exist only in classes (.cb, .ctp, .cbt). The see-all circle is an '<a style="display:block;width:40px;...background-color:#F5B100">', which Outlook shows as a highlighted arrow. The eyebrow dots and the hero '+' are sized <div>s. Only the hero primary button has VML; the closing and secondary CTAs depend on <a> padding, which Outlook drops.
The hero and closing CTA go to the bare 'https://covered.ro/?utm…' instead of the verified '/#alege-telefonul'. The social pills are 42px. The 9.5px mono meta labels appear 12 times.

strengths: The most robust container: a fluid-hybrid table (width:100%; max-width:600px) inside an MSO ghost table of 600. It shrinks even without media queries: stripped of <style> it measures 507px at 375, against a fixed 600 for A and C.

Accessibility wrapper '<div role="article" aria-roledescription="email" aria-label="−30% la 2 skinuri" lang="ro">'. Nav cells are 45px tall, and the see-all rows use 'display:block;padding:22px 0' on the link, giving a 64px tap target.

Main CTAs are padding-based bulletproof buttons with mso-padding-alt on the <td>. The source is the cleanest: hrefs are &-escaped, only 6 lines exceed 998 characters (max 3,359), and utm_content is the most granular (nav, hero-exemplu, iphone, iphone-toate, strip-1, strip-2, modele-noi, noutati-toate…). All 55 covered.ro links returned 200, including /products/skin-samsung-burgundy.
Hero contrast is very strong (#0A0A0B on #F5B100 is 10.5:1, #3B2D06 on #F5B100 is 7.1:1), and its hero alt text is #0A0A0B on yellow, so it stays readable with images blocked.
weaknesses: The Gmail and Samsung link reset will probably break CTAs. 'u+#body a,#MessageViewBody a{color:inherit!important;...font-size:inherit!important;font-family:inherit!important;line-height:inherit!important}' uses !important, so it beats every inline link style. In a simulation with the Gmail <u></u><div id="body"> wrapper, the closing yellow 'ALEGE-ȚI TELEFONUL →' turns #F3F3EF on #F5B100 (about 1.8:1) and wraps. Both yellow offer strips become white-on-yellow. Nav and 'VEZI SKINUL' jump to 16px. The underlines on 'Vezi emailul în browser' and 'Dezabonare' disappear.

The MSO override lists only 'body,table,td,p,a,span,h1,h2', not div. The 14 card titles are '<div class="tt" style="font-family:Archivo,...">', which risks Outlook falling back to Times New Roman. The hero H1 spans have no whitespace between them, giving '−30%LA 2 SKINURI.' in Outlook.

The ruler ticks are 25 empty <td>/<div> styled only by classes (.rt0, .rm, .rM). Outlook ignores height on <div>, so they may render as solid blocks, and they vanish when <style> is stripped. The 14 per-card 'VEZI SKINUL' ghost buttons rely on <a> padding with no mso-padding-alt, so they collapse to text height in Outlook and are 42px tall elsewhere.

Heaviest image payload: 1.66 MB across 17 PNGs, with product shots requested at width=400 for a 150px display (2.7x). The 9.5px size is used 35 times (badges, '−30% CÂND IEI 2' labels, mobile '/ buc.'). Card alignment depends on a fixed 'height:38px' title div, which Outlook ignores.

between every display:block pair: the hero H1 lines and A-style device tiles such as '199 de skinuri' / 'iPhone' / 'Vezi skinuri'. Outlook ignores display:block on span and runs them together ('−30%LA 2SKINURI.'). Use separate
s or

Alt-text colour must contrast with the background of the cell that holds the image. A's hero uses #45433E on #111113 (1.91:1); check every image cell, because Outlook blocks images by default.

Make every interactive element at least 44px tall. The Instagram/TikTok pills are 14+14+14 = 42px in all variants; use 15px vertical padding. Make the see-all label a padded block link instead of bare text beside the 40px circle.

Keep the final HTML under 90 KB after grafting (C is at 83,858 B) and keep every source line under 998 characters. A has 31 such lines (max 10,128) and C has 8 (max 5,255). Hard-wrap between tags so MTAs that do not quoted-printable-encode cannot split attributes.

Extend the MSO font override to cover all elements ('*{font-family:Arial,sans-serif!important}', as in A and C, not B's selector list). Otherwise divs with an inline Archivo stack can fall back to Times New Roman in Outlook.
